problem_statement: Headers lookups are case sensitive: after Headers({'Content-Type': 'x'}), get('content-type') returns None. HTTP header names are case insensitive.
test_patch:
--- a/tests/test_httpkit_headers.py
+++ b/tests/test_httpkit_headers.py
@@ -13,3 +13,11 @@
     h = Headers()
     h.set("Host", "example.org")
     assert h.get("Host") == "example.org"
+
+
+def test_get_is_case_insensitive():
+    assert Headers({"Content-Type": "x"}).get("content-type") == "x"
+
+
+def test_contains_is_case_insensitive():
+    assert "ACCEPT" in Headers({"Accept": "a"})
